rationale: T068 proves only a successful non-standalone production build; T070 stopped before deletion and produced no fresh runtime evidence. The current .next is a normal directory with no reparse descendants or standalone tree, and port 3101 is free. A no-deletion next start pass is safe. The configured e2e/a11y/visual scripts use next dev and cannot consume this existing production output without config changes. Prior visual diagnostics had 3/3 mismatches and the broader brief remains incomplete.

worker_package.objective: Run one sole no-deletion runtime diagnostics pass against the existing apps/web/.next verification output. Start it with next start on 127.0.0.1:3101, collect HTTP smoke checks, Playwright CLI light-desktop, 390px-mobile, and dark screenshots, and an inline Playwright/Axe result. Persist only new diagnostics under test-results/t071-runtime. Do not clean or rebuild .next, modify source/configuration/content/reports/snapshots, run visual:update, approve baselines, or alter standalone/Docker behavior.
verify: Preflight 127.0.0.1:3101 and proceed only when free; assert apps/web/.next is exact target with no reparse descendants; record before hashes for .next, source, next.config.ts, build-boundary.ts, and tests/browser/snapshots.
Start only existing output with pnpm --filter @paper-and-slate/web exec next start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3101; record owned PID and command line.
Run Invoke-WebRequest smoke checks against /, /health, /docs, /projects, and /search; require successful responses and stop the owned server afterward.
Run Playwright CLI screenshots for 1440x900 light, 390x844 mobile, and 1440x900 dark into test-results/t071-runtime.
Run inline Node Playwright/AxeBuilder check against the root and write JSON only under test-results/t071-runtime/axe.json.
Repeat reparse scan and before/after hashes; verify snapshots, source, configuration, Docker files, and .next are unchanged and visual:update did not run.
stop_if: Port 3101 is occupied by unknown process or ownership cannot be established.
apps/web/.next is a reparse point, any descendant is a reparse point, or cleanup/build/dev operation would be required.
next start changes .next, source, configuration, snapshots, content, or any path outside test-results/t071-runtime.
Existing output cannot serve required smoke routes.
Browser or Axe check fails twice for same cause or artifacts cannot be written only beneath test-results/t071-runtime.
Configured browser scripts require next dev/config changes, visual:update runs, snapshots change, assertions weaken, or any mismatch is approved.

evidence: T068 records build:verify passing twice with output guards, exit propagation, unchanged source/configuration/Dockerfile checks, and preserved default standalone behavior.
T070 records cleanup rejected before deletion and no files changed.
Current apps/web/.next is a normal directory with no standalone tree or reparse descendants; port 3101 is FREE.
package scripts and Playwright config bind the normal browser commands to next dev on port 3101, so a no-deletion next start harness is needed for existing output.
Prior visual diagnostics recorded 3/3 mismatches with snapshots unchanged.

parallel_safety.reason: The runtime owns port 3101, reads shared .next, and produces shared browser diagnostics; run one sole Worker with no parallel runtime or snapshot work.
